text_markup: {n}Some abilities state that the Runner "cannot access more than 1 card" during a particular run. The effect of this ability is that as long as the Runner has accessed a card during the indicated run, they are prohibited from accessing other cards during that run. The ability has no effect on breaches or candidates until a card has been accessed, and for breaches of HQ and R&D, it never affects the random access limit, even if a card was accessed before the breach began.{/n}
text_plain: Some abilities state that the Runner "cannot access more than 1 card" during a particular run. The effect of this ability is that as long as the Runner has accessed a card during the indicated run, they are prohibited from accessing other cards during that run. The ability has no effect on breaches or candidates until a card has been accessed, and for breaches of HQ and R&D, it never affects the random access limit, even if a card was accessed before the breach began.

examples.text_markup: The Runner breaches HQ during a run on HQ while {card:Flagship} is rezzed in the root of HQ, and they have an installed copy of {card:Docklands Pass}, but they have previously accessed a card during that run because of {card:Otoroshi}'s ability. The random access limit is still set to 2, but since the Runner is not allowed to access any cards other than {card:Flagship}, none of the cards in the Corp's hand will be candidates. If {card:Flagship}'s ability becomes inactive before the breach ends, the cards in the Corp's hand will become candidates and the Runner will be able to access 2 of them.
